name: Malang
scopeLimits: The point lies within the catalog’s nationwide bounding rectangle, which is only a coarse extent, not proof of local coverage. No exact Malang village/urban parcel match, public feature, geometry or identifier was verified. No owner or address fields were requested or retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The national ATR/BPN BHUMI parcel catalog provides a candidate layer whose broad bounding rectangle includes Malang. No primary local registry link, city selector or actual Malang parcel response was verified; nationwide bounds alone do not establish a city-specific registry.

executedQueries.query: Malang official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN Kota Malang peta bidang tanah GIS
executedQueries.result: Official ATR/BPN BHUMI public catalog lists the national Bidang Tanah layer (umum:Persil), whose bounding box includes the Malang WUP coordinate. The viewer client code traces identify through GeoServer WMS GetFeatureInfo via /expapi/getPersil. The catalog’s service root and plausible WFS/WMS capability paths returned 404; no parcel geometry was obtained.
executedQueries.method: Separate English search; official catalog inspection, client bundle trace and bounded endpoint availability checks.

executedQueries.method: Separate Indonesian-language search and review of the official BHUMI layer catalog and viewer code.

officialSources.observation: Official BHUMI map page and client bundle. Its feature-info code constructs GeoServer WMS GetFeatureInfo for visible 2D layers and routes the request to /expapi/getPersil.
Published/default catalog contains Bidang Tanah, umum:Persil, bounds [94.2543556955413,-9.93667708865449]–[140.80540914949,7.65416298406574], and fields penggunaan, tipehak, luas, nib, akurasibidang.
Catalog-listed GeoServer service root did not return WFS capabilities.
Catalog service root and plausible WFS/WMS URL paths tested during client trace returned HTTP 404; no feature response was available.

viewerAndServiceTrace.bundleTrace: The public map app identifies published layer metadata by map_service_url/map_service_layer_name and vendor Geoserver. For parcel identify it forms WMS 1.1.1 GetFeatureInfo with query_layers, bbox, EPSG:4326 viewport coordinates, and FEATURE_COUNT=5, then invokes /expapi/getPersil with service URL and click parameters. The catalog service root tested returned 404, so no point request returned a feature.
viewerAndServiceTrace.clientIdentify: /expapi/getPersil (POST proxy; feature-info route traced, not a successful geometry response)
